verdict.rationale: Ollama ships a one-line installer and runs its own local server (the OpenAPI spec targets http://localhost:11434), so the core product runs on the user's own hardware with local data handling. Community users independently confirm running it locally and in vendor-shipped ROCm containers. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the open-source license and of production/server self-hosting deployment (containers, remote hosting configuration).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
Ollama is definitely the easiest way to run LLMs locally
